rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial Hong Kong Cantonese word for a lift carrying people or goods.

example.english: We took the elevator to the tenth floor.
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 daap3 lip1 soeng5 sap6 lau4

rows.note: Use this for a grain-storage silo or granary, not for a passenger lift.

example.english: This grain elevator is used to store wheat.
example.traditional: 呢座穀倉用嚟儲存小麥。
example.jyutping: ni1 zo6 guk1 cong1 jung6 lei4 cyu4 cyun4 siu2 mak6
